Material deliberately refused under the seam includes PBW, finite root/Dynkin/highest-weight classification, CE signs and Whitehead, general Ext/derived/spectral-sequence machinery, and analytic real-reductive representation theory. Kazhdan–Lusztig/cell theory, full localisation, quantum/crystal/global bases, vertex/Virasoro theory, and modular representation theory were also not minted because their required foundations are absent. Duflo remains with an explicitly `not-supplied` localisation proof; Borel–Weil–Bott has a recorded AV forward reference.

Scaffold blockers: none. Future build holds are the still-empty DG suppliers and the unassigned AV geometry suppliers; both were recorded without prompting.
